standouts.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 35)
standouts.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 35, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
standouts.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

standouts.head: Accumulation
standouts.text: In five weeks it had 5 up days and 0 down days on volume above both the day before and its average.
standouts.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.

against.head: Resistance +1.2% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.2% above (0.4 ATR): the Apr 21 high, the Jan 30 low and the Feb 9 low: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Broke out of a 4-week base
material.text: On Nov 5 it closed above the base's top (14% deep), on 1.7x average volume. 4 of the 4 closes from the break on held above the level it broke, and the break session closed 2.9 ATR past it on a 2.5-ATR range: a stretched spike.
material.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Nov 19, 2025 low, the 50-week average and the most-traded price of six months, where 9 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the June high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Next support −2.4% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −2.4% below (0.9 ATR), where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet: the May 4 low, the 200-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Aug 6–Oct 6 drop.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Back above its averages
material.text: Price has climbed back above both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.
